scope: Existing Test0001SingleDocumentBackfill in fresh kind clusters; local same-session cache experiment
limitations: Single observation per phase; dependencies and application images already built.
Bazel wall time excludes fingerprint preparation, image building and archival of test logs.
Actual migration is not accelerated. An unchanged test result skips the entire environment lifecycle.
ES7 changes the declared scenario and verifies invalidation; it is not an execution-speed comparison with ES8.
Helm chart downloads and third-party image tags are not fully pinned; cache reuse is experimental and session-scoped.
Local Docker, nftables and tmpfs workaround differ from Jenkins; teardown deletes the entire private cluster.
Earlier harness bring-up failures are excluded from successful-run timings; no production changes were needed.
